name: Moody's
description: Moody's is the second-largest credit rating agency and also a risk-software and data vendor. Moody's Investors Service (53 percent of revenue, 70 percent of adjusted operating income) is paid by bond issuers for each rating and for ongoing monitoring, so its revenue follows debt issuance: corporate finance ratings were $2.1 billion of $4.1 billion in 2025. Moody's Analytics (47 percent of revenue) sells subscription data, research and software for banks, insurers and know-your-customer compliance, with annualised recurring revenue of $3.5 billion. Adjusted operating margin is 64 percent in ratings and 33 percent in analytics.

employees.note: Moody's Investors Service 6,128, Moody's Analytics 7,803, shared services 2,145 (10-K workforce table; total 16,076).

businessLines.name: Moody's Investors Service (MIS)
businessLines.how: Issuers pay a fee to have debt rated, largely as a percentage of the issue size at issuance, plus annual monitoring fees on rated debt; revenue rises and falls with bond and loan issuance volumes.

businessLines.how: Subscription and licence fees for software and data: Decision Solutions (banking, insurance and KYC workflows), Research and Insights (credit research and economic data) and Data and Information (company and security data feeds); mostly recurring, annual contracts renewing.
